_comment: Leaves that only their path can disambiguate, plus in-place fixes to text too long to quote whole (`find`/`replace`). See apply_path_patches.py.

patches.path: Menace Under Otari.journals.Menace Under Otari.pages.Xulgath Cave.text
patches.why: Baseline is `@Check[type:fortitude|dc:19]{Fortitude save}`. The seeded translation lost both the `type:` key inside the brackets and the label's opening brace, so Foundry rendered the check followed by a literal `豁免}`.
Baseline label is `Encounter Budget`; only the first word was translated. Not a gloss - dropping `Budget` would have deleted the meaning, which is why the gloss stripper refused it.
